text.hi: ‘should’ का मतलब ‘चाहिए’। We should plant trees = हमें पेड़ लगाने चाहिए। ‘should not’ = नहीं चाहिए। We should not waste water.
text.hinglish: ‘should’ ka matlab ‘chahiye’. We should plant trees = Humein ped lagaane chahiye. ‘should not’ = nahi chahiye. We should not waste water.
text.en: ‘Should’ tells us what is right to do. We should plant trees. ‘Should not’ tells us what not to do. We should not waste water.
